positions.name: MissingIdSlugTestContract
positions.frame: what must a test case guarantee when reproducing the missing-id failure pattern from production?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the test reproduces a concrete prod failure (missing id on a ## heading); src-2 states the non-negotiable behavioral contract for that scenario (no crash, valid slug). Both share one directional read: the test case is being defined by pairing the reproduced defect with the required safe outcome — conviction analysis marks src-1 as a plain claim and src-2 as a settled operational rule, but they cohere as the two halves of a single test-contract statement rather than as competing stances.
